name: Frontier Justice
description: The Arizona Territory in 1882, where law is scarce and justice comes from the barrel of a gun.
seed_prompt: A classic Western setting of outlaws, lawmen, and ordinary folks trying to survive on the frontier.
lore_content:
Dusty Springs sits at the crossroads of the cattle trail and the railroad expansion. What started as a mining camp has grown into a town of five hundred souls, each with their own story of hope or desperation.

Marshal Jake Thornton came west to escape his past as a Confederate officer. Now he tries to bring order to a lawless land, though his quick draw and quicker temper make enemies as often as they solve problems. He's haunted by the men he killed in the war.

Miss Sarah Chen runs the Golden Dragon saloon, one of the only Chinese-owned businesses tolerated in town. Her establishment serves the best whiskey and the freshest information. She's paid dearly for her position and protects it fiercely.

The Garrett Gang has robbed every bank between here and Santa Fe. Their leader, 'Bloody' Bill Garrett, is wanted dead or alive for murder and train robbery. What the posters don't mention is that he only steals from the railroad barons who destroyed his family's farm.

Doctor Elizabeth Foster is the only physician within a hundred miles. A widow who learned medicine from her husband before consumption took him, she treats gunfighters and farmers alike. Some say she has secrets from her time in Boston.

Reverend John Crow preaches hellfire every Sunday, but he spends his nights at the card tables. His past as a gambler and gunman catches up with him whenever a stranger rides into town.

Jonas Black Eagle straddles two worlds - raised by Apache but educated at a missionary school. He works as a scout for the Army while secretly helping his people avoid the reservation. His loyalties will soon be tested beyond breaking.

The Copper King, Ezekiel Morton, owns the mines and half the town. His private army of Pinkertons enforces his will. He's dying of consumption and desperate to build a legacy before the end.
